cases.name: Berta Mae Parker
cases.about: Her obituary said Bertha was a devoted and loving mother and grandmother. She cherished her family and enjoyed spending as much time as possible with them all. She worked as a home health aid where she was able to continually care for those in need.

cases.name: Elizabeth “Esu” Cleveland Lackey
cases.about: Her obituary said she was a loving mother and dedicated wife with a profound love of dogs and mystery novels, she was always open to new ideas and devoted much of her life to advancing social justice and raising awareness of the role of class and institutional bias in limiting opportunity for women and the poor.
